class_name EnemyFactionMap
extends RefCounted


const _FACTION_MAP := {
    Unit.EnemyType.GRUNT: "mutant",
    Unit.EnemyType.HEAVY: "machine",
    Unit.EnemyType.SNIPER: "mutant",
    Unit.EnemyType.DRONE: "machine",
    Unit.EnemyType.ELITE: "mutant",
    Unit.EnemyType.RAIDER: "mutant",
    Unit.EnemyType.SHOTGUNNER: "mutant",
    Unit.EnemyType.SHIELD: "machine",
    Unit.EnemyType.MINIGUNNER: "machine",
    Unit.EnemyType.BOSS: "machine",
    Unit.EnemyType.BOMBER: "mutant",
    Unit.EnemyType.ARC_GUNNER: "machine",
}

## Maps enemy archetypes to their faction for achievement tracking.
## "machine" for mechanical/robotic units, "mutant" for biological/organic
units.
static func get_faction(unit_type: Unit.EnemyType) -> String:
    return _FACTION_MAP.get(unit_type, "")

static func get_all_factions() -> Dictionary:
    var result := {}
    for t in CodexData.ENEMY_ORDER:
        result[str(t)] = get_faction(t)
    return result


I will remove the doc comments and the get_faction function.
